title: Signed Graph Balancing in Linear Time
venue: ACM GPGPU 2026 (18th Workshop on General Purpose Processing Using GPU)
gpu_scope: ECL-SGB: linear-time CUDA algorithm balancing fundamental cycles of a signed graph without per-cycle traversal; 11.9x/13.6x speedup on RTX 4090/A100.
notes: From the same ECL (Texas State) lab behind ECL-MaxFlow already validated in this catalog; newest and most directly matching artifact for this problem.
